  • Flags: "free ticket" = pick up at the Children's desk before the program (Hayward rule — see Closures: free ticket 30 min before, every adult AND child, no advance reservations).   • All library events are free unless noted. Non-library sources (bookstores, parks, museums, zoos, nature, art studios, Eventbrite, parent calendars) are mostly PAID — costs shown distinctly (PAID/FREE) in Beyond.
  • Layout: each day is split into Storytimes vs Activities (nearest-first within each). A Nearest | Earliest | Latest toggle re-sorts every list; all-day events go in the All-day bucket. The For you tab picks by age and city; the Digest tab has the full day lists plus an age bar (All / Baby / Toddler / Preschool / Ages 7+ / Free) and one shared search bar.
